title: Toromona - Wikipedia
text: Bolivia's Administrative Resolution 48/2006, issued on 15 August 2006, created an "exclusive, reserved, and inviolable" portion of the Madidi National Park to protect the Toromona. [2] The Toromona language is a Tacanan language. [1] No non-natives have contacted this tribe.

title: Toromona language - Wikipedia
text: Toromona (Toromono) is a Western Tacanan language. 200 Toromono were reported in 1983, but they have not been located since. [citation needed] It is poorly attested, but is recorded in wordlists. [2][3][failed verification] However, the wordlists appear to be identical to Ese Ejja.
